```{r setup, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
if (interactive()) setwd(root)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(MASS)

library(ROI)
select <- dplyr::select   # MASS masks select()
```

## 1. Model and baseline (from Part 1)

The severe model is the Part 1 negative binomial (`06_forecast.Rmd`): visitors as an offset, month, weather, beach traits and the safety levers, with lifeguard and drone hours entering as `log1p(hours)` (diminishing returns). The baseline is its FY2027 forecast (Sep 2026 to Aug 2027, safety at FY2026 levels, weather replayed over the 10 past years).

Safety terms add to the linear predictor, so changing them multiplies every weather replay by the same factor: `mu_new = mu0 * exp(delta)` is exact, with `mu0` the replay-averaged forecast.

```{r data-model}
fy27      <- readRDS("part1/forecast_fy2027.rds")
glm_fit   <- fy27$final$sev
panel_f   <- readRDS("part1/panel_f.rds")

win <- fy27$newdata %>%
  left_join(fy27$forecast %>% select(beach_nm, mon, mu0 = mu_sev), by = c("beach_nm", "mon")) %>%
  arrange(beach_nm, month_date)
stopifnot(nrow(win) == 960, !anyNA(win$mu0))

b    <- coef(glm_fit)
b_lg <- b[["log_lg"]];       b_dr <- b[["log_drone"]]
b_c  <- b[["campaign_idx"]]; b_fa <- b[["first_aid_cap"]]
b_pa <- b[["pa_system"]];    b_fl <- b[["flags"]]
print(round(summary(glm_fit)$coefficients[c("log_lg", "log_drone", "campaign_idx", "first_aid_cap", "pa_system", "flags"), ], 4))

# A lever with a coefficient >= 0 does nothing for severe incidents, so it is left out.
levers <- c(log_lg = b_lg, log_drone = b_dr, campaign_idx = b_c, first_aid_cap = b_fa, pa_system = b_pa, flags = b_fl)
cat("Not bought (coefficient >= 0):", paste(names(levers)[levers >= 0], collapse = ", "), "\n")
b_fa <- min(b_fa, 0); b_pa <- min(b_pa, 0)

beach_ids <- unique(win$beach_nm)
pc_ids    <- sort(unique(win$postcode))
win <- win %>% mutate(r = row_number(), b = match(beach_nm, beach_ids), p = match(postcode, pc_ids),
                      cal = as.integer(as.character(mon)))

baseline_total <- sum(win$mu0)
cat("Planning year:", format(min(win$month_date), "%b %Y"), "to", format(max(win$month_date), "%b %Y"), "\n")
cat("Baseline expected severe incidents (FY2027 forecast):", round(baseline_total, 2), "\n")
```

## 2. Prices and settings

```{r prices}
prices <- read.csv("part1/pricing.csv")
price  <- function(x) prices$cost_fd[match(x, prices$item)]

BUDGET     <- 2e6
AMORT      <- 1      # years to spread one-off costs over (1 = full cash cost this year)
K          <- 10     # tangent lines per beach-month for the exp() approximation
TIME_LIMIT <- 600    # solver time limit, seconds
MAX_FTE    <- 2      # max full-time lifeguards per beach

DRONE_CAP  <- 120    # flight hours / month per drone
FTE_HRS    <- 1750   # lifeguard hours / FTE / year
FTE_H      <- FTE_HRS / 12
CAMP_LEVEL <- 0.7
SUMMER     <- c(11, 12, 1, 2)

c_lg      <- price("Casual SLSC lifeguard")
c_fte     <- price("Full-time SLSC lifeguard") + price("Full-time recruitment") / AMORT
c_dr_hr   <- price("Drone operator (casual)")
c_dr_buy  <- (price("Drone hardware") + price("Drone operator training")) / AMORT
c_camp    <- price("Beach safety education campaign")
c_fl      <- price("Rip-warning flags/signage") / AMORT
stopifnot(!anyNA(c(c_lg, c_fte, c_dr_hr, c_dr_buy, c_camp, c_fl)))
```

## 3. Precompute what each purchase can change

Lifeguard and drone hours enter as `log1p`, so the decision variables are the **log-gains** `tl = log1p(lg0 + x) - log1p(lg0)` (and `td` for drones). The incident effect is then linear in them (`b_lg * tl`). The hours they need, `(1 + lg0) * (exp(tl) - 1)`, are convex in `tl`, so the hours paid for must lie above a set of chord lines through a grid of hours. Chords sit above the curve, so the cost is never understated.

```{r precompute}
N <- nrow(win); B <- length(beach_ids); P <- length(pc_ids)
bi  <- win$b
pci <- win$p

LG_CAP  <- max(panel_f$lg_hrs)                    # do not extrapolate past observed hours
lg_room <- pmax(LG_CAP - win$lg_hrs, 0)

# A new patrol at an unpatrolled beach-month must be at least as big as the smallest patrols
# actually run (5th percentile of patrolled months). Without this, log1p gives a few hours a
# large effect and the solver spreads unrosterable 1-10 hour patrols everywhere.
MIN_LG  <- unname(quantile(panel_f$lg_hrs[panel_f$lg_hrs > 0], 0.05))
cat("Minimum new patrol block:", round(MIN_LG), "hours / month\n")

# Drones: existing equipment if the beach already flies in FY2026
have_b  <- as.numeric(tapply(win$drone_hrs, win$b, max) > 0)
dcap_b  <- pmax(DRONE_CAP, as.numeric(tapply(win$drone_hrs, win$b, max)))
room_dr <- ifelse(have_b[bi] == 1, pmax(dcap_b[bi] - win$drone_hrs, 0), 0)
new_dr  <- ifelse(have_b[bi] == 1, 0, DRONE_CAP)

fl_mask   <- as.numeric(win$flags == 0)
camp_gain <- ifelse(win$cal %in% SUMMER, pmax(CAMP_LEVEL - win$campaign_idx, 0), 0)

# largest log-gain each row can reach
tl_max <- log1p(win$lg_hrs + lg_room) - log1p(win$lg_hrs)
td_ex  <- log1p(win$drone_hrs + room_dr) - log1p(win$drone_hrs)   # existing drones
td_new <- log1p(new_dr)                                            # needs a new drone (drone_hrs = 0 there)

# chord lines: hours >= A + M * t, one per grid segment, padded to a fixed count
chords <- function(base, room, grid) {
  H <- sort(unique(c(grid[grid < room], room)))
  if (room <= 0) return(matrix(0, 1, 2))
  t <- log1p(base + H) - log1p(base)
  M <- diff(H) / diff(t)
  cbind(A = H[-length(H)] - M * t[-length(t)], M = M)
}
pad <- function(lst) { n <- max(sapply(lst, nrow))
  lapply(lst, function(m) rbind(m, m[rep(nrow(m), n - nrow(m)), , drop = FALSE])) }
LG_GRID <- c(0, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048)
DR_GRID <- c(0, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96)
ch_l <- pad(lapply(seq_len(N), function(r) chords(win$lg_hrs[r], lg_room[r], LG_GRID)))
ch_d <- pad(lapply(seq_len(N), function(r) chords(win$drone_hrs[r], room_dr[r] + new_dr[r], DR_GRID)))
KL <- nrow(ch_l[[1]]); KD <- nrow(ch_d[[1]])
Al <- t(sapply(ch_l, `[`, , 1)); Ml <- t(sapply(ch_l, `[`, , 2))
Ad <- t(sapply(ch_d, `[`, , 1)); Md <- t(sapply(ch_d, `[`, , 2))

# Tangent lines for mu = mu0 * exp(delta)
d_min <- b_lg * tl_max + b_dr * pmax(td_ex, td_new) + b_fl * fl_mask + b_c * camp_gain
d0  <- t(sapply(d_min, function(m) seq(m, 0, length.out = K)))
S   <- win$mu0 * exp(d0)
Cst <- S * (1 - d0)

# only model beach-months that can shed incidents (nearly all of them)
pot   <- win$mu0 * (1 - exp(d_min))
act   <- which(pot > 1e-6)
isact <- as.numeric(seq_len(N) %in% act)
act0  <- act[win$lg_hrs[act] == 0 & lg_room[act] >= MIN_LG]   # unpatrolled rows: new patrol needs a full block
cat("Modelled beach-months:", length(act), "of", N, "\n")

need_fl   <- as.numeric(tapply(fl_mask * isact, win$b, max))
need_camp <- as.numeric(tapply(camp_gain * isact, win$p, max) > 0)
have_act  <- as.numeric(tapply(isact, win$b, max) > 0)
```

## 4. The MILP

```{r model}
model <- MIPModel() %>%
  # row-level (beach-month) variables
  add_variable(tl[r],  r = act, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%   # log-gain from extra lifeguard hours
  add_variable(td[r],  r = act, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%   # log-gain from extra drone hours
  add_variable(cas[r], r = act, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%   # extra casual lifeguard hours
  add_variable(dh[r],  r = act, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%   # extra drone flight hours
  add_variable(z[r],   r = act, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%   # expected severe incidents (epigraph)
  add_variable(on[r],  r = act0, type = "binary") %>%              # start a patrol at an unpatrolled beach-month
  # beach-level
  add_variable(fte[i],  i = 1:B, type = "integer", lb = 0, ub = MAX_FTE) %>%
  add_variable(ydr[i],  i = 1:B, type = "binary") %>%              # buy drone + operator training
  add_variable(flag[i], i = 1:B, type = "binary") %>%
  # postcode-level
  add_variable(camp[j], j = 1:P, type = "binary") %>%
  set_objective(sum_expr(z[r], r = act), "min") %>%
  # tangent-line approximation of mu0 * exp(delta)
  add_constraint(
    z[r] >= S[r, k] * (b_lg * tl[r] + b_dr * td[r] + b_fl * fl_mask[r] * flag[bi[r]] +
                       b_c * camp_gain[r] * camp[pci[r]]) + Cst[r, k],
    r = act, k = 1:K
  ) %>%
  # hours paid for must cover the log-gain (chords: never under-costed)
  add_constraint(cas[r] + FTE_H * fte[bi[r]] >= Al[r, k] + Ml[r, k] * tl[r], r = act, k = 1:KL) %>%
  add_constraint(dh[r] >= Ad[r, k] + Md[r, k] * td[r], r = act, k = 1:KD) %>%
  # physical limits
  add_constraint(tl[r] <= tl_max[r], r = act) %>%
  add_constraint(tl[r] <= tl_max[r] * on[r], r = act0) %>%
  add_constraint(cas[r] + FTE_H * fte[bi[r]] >= MIN_LG * on[r], r = act0) %>%
  add_constraint(td[r] <= td_ex[r] + td_new[r] * ydr[bi[r]], r = act) %>%
  add_constraint(cas[r] + FTE_H * fte[bi[r]] <= lg_room[r] + FTE_H * MAX_FTE * (1 - isact[r]), r = act) %>%
  add_constraint(dh[r] <= room_dr[r] + new_dr[r] * ydr[bi[r]], r = act) %>%
  # only buy what can have an effect
  add_constraint(ydr[i]  <= (1 - have_b[i]) * have_act[i], i = 1:B) %>%
  add_constraint(fte[i]  <= MAX_FTE * have_act[i], i = 1:B) %>%
  add_constraint(flag[i] <= need_fl[i],   i = 1:B) %>%
  add_constraint(camp[j] <= need_camp[j], j = 1:P) %>%
  # budget
  add_constraint(
    sum_expr(c_lg * cas[r] + c_dr_hr * dh[r], r = act) +
    sum_expr(c_fte * fte[i] + c_dr_buy * ydr[i] + c_fl * flag[i], i = 1:B) +
    sum_expr(c_camp * camp[j], j = 1:P) <= BUDGET
  )
```

The ROI plugin passes only a time limit to HiGHS, so the model goes to the `highs` package directly, with a 1% optimality gap (HiGHS's default is 0.01%, which can take far longer to prove).

```{r solve}
with_highs <- function(gap, time_limit) function(model) {
  cons  <- extract_constraints(model)
  bnd   <- variable_bounds(model)
  types <- variable_types(model)
  out <- highs::highs_solve(
    L = as.numeric(objective_function(model)$solution),
    lower = bnd$lower, upper = ifelse(types == "binary", pmin(bnd$upper, 1), bnd$upper),
    A = cons$matrix,
    lhs = ifelse(cons$sense %in% c(">=", "=="), cons$rhs, -Inf),
    rhs = ifelse(cons$sense %in% c("<=", "=="), cons$rhs, Inf),
    types = ifelse(types == "continuous", "C", "I"),
    control = highs::highs_control(time_limit = time_limit, mip_rel_gap = gap))
  new_solution(model, objective_value = out$objective_value,
               status = if (out$status == 7) "success" else "error",
               solution = setNames(out$primal_solution, variable_keys(model)),
               additional_solver_output = list(highs = out))
}
res <- solve_model(model, with_highs(gap = 0.01, time_limit = TIME_LIMIT))
hs  <- additional_solver_output(res)$highs
cat("Solver status:", res$status, "|", hs$status_message, "| MIP gap:", signif(hs$info$mip_gap, 2), "\n")
```

## 5. Results (recomputed exactly from the Part 1 model)

The effect is recomputed from the hours actually bought, not from the solver's log-gains, so it is exact and matches the cost.

```{r results}
fill_rows <- function(df) { v <- numeric(N); v[df$r] <- df$value; v }
cas_v  <- fill_rows(get_solution(res, cas[r]))
dh_v   <- fill_rows(get_solution(res, dh[r]))
fte_v  <- get_solution(res, fte[i])  %>% arrange(i) %>% pull(value) %>% round()
ydr_v  <- get_solution(res, ydr[i])  %>% arrange(i) %>% pull(value) %>% round()
flag_v <- get_solution(res, flag[i]) %>% arrange(i) %>% pull(value) %>% round()
camp_v <- get_solution(res, camp[j]) %>% arrange(j) %>% pull(value) %>% round()

# delta for any purchase plan, so alternatives are scored the same way
plan_delta <- function(lg_add, dr_add, flag_b, camp_p, bb = b) {
  lg_add <- pmin(lg_add, lg_room)
  bb[["log_lg"]] * (log1p(win$lg_hrs + lg_add) - log1p(win$lg_hrs)) +
    bb[["log_drone"]] * (log1p(win$drone_hrs + dr_add) - log1p(win$drone_hrs)) +
    bb[["flags"]] * fl_mask * flag_b[bi] + bb[["campaign_idx"]] * camp_gain * camp_p[pci]
}
lg_add <- cas_v + FTE_H * fte_v[bi]
d_eta  <- plan_delta(lg_add, dh_v, flag_v, camp_v)
win$mu_new <- win$mu0 * exp(d_eta)

cost <- c(
  casual_lifeguards = c_lg * sum(cas_v),
  full_time_lifeguards = c_fte * sum(fte_v),
  drone_hours = c_dr_hr * sum(dh_v),
  drone_hardware_training = c_dr_buy * sum(ydr_v),
  campaigns = c_camp * sum(camp_v),
  flags = c_fl * sum(flag_v)
)
stopifnot(sum(cost) <= BUDGET + 1)

avoided <- baseline_total - sum(win$mu_new)
cat(sprintf("Spent %s of %s\n", format(round(sum(cost)), big.mark = ","), format(BUDGET, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Expected severe incidents: %.1f -> %.1f  (%.1f avoided, %.1f%%)\n",
            baseline_total, sum(win$mu_new), avoided, 100 * avoided / baseline_total))
cat(sprintf("Cost per severe incident avoided: $%s\n", format(round(sum(cost) / avoided, -3), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("MILP objective (tangent approximation, a lower bound on incidents): %.1f\n",
            sum(get_solution(res, z[r])$value) + sum(win$mu0[-act])))
print(round(cost))
```

```{r allocation}
by_beach <- tibble(
  beach = beach_ids,
  postcode = win %>% group_by(b) %>% summarise(p = first(postcode)) %>% pull(p),
  casual_lg_hrs = as.numeric(tapply(cas_v, bi, sum)),
  fte = fte_v, drone_bought = ydr_v, drone_hrs = as.numeric(tapply(dh_v, bi, sum)),
  flags = flag_v,
  winter_lg_hrs = as.numeric(tapply(lg_add * (win$cal %in% 5:8), bi, sum)),
  expected_before = as.numeric(tapply(win$mu0, bi, sum)),
  expected_after  = as.numeric(tapply(win$mu_new, bi, sum))
) %>%
  mutate(avoided = expected_before - expected_after) %>%
  filter(casual_lg_hrs > 0.5 | fte > 0 | drone_bought > 0 | drone_hrs > 0.5 | flags > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(avoided))

by_postcode <- tibble(postcode = pc_ids, campaign = camp_v) %>% filter(campaign > 0)

by_month <- win %>% mutate(lg_add = lg_add, dh = dh_v) %>% group_by(cal) %>%
  summarise(extra_lg_hrs = sum(lg_add), extra_drone_hrs = sum(dh), avoided = sum(mu0 - mu_new))

knitr::kable(by_beach, digits = 2)
by_postcode
knitr::kable(by_month, digits = 1)
cat("Beaches funded:", nrow(by_beach), "| top 10 share of avoided:",
    round(sum(head(by_beach$avoided, 10)) / avoided, 2),
    "| May-Aug share of avoided:", round(sum(by_month$avoided[by_month$cal %in% 5:8]) / avoided, 2), "\n")

write.csv(by_beach, "part2/optimal_allocation_by_beach.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(by_postcode, "part2/optimal_allocation_by_postcode.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 6. Uncertainty

Same three sources as Part 1 section 5: weather (one past year for the whole coast), parameters (`mvrnorm(coef, vcov)`) and chance (negative binomial draws). The allocation is held fixed; each draw scores it with that draw's coefficients.

```{r unc}
set.seed(2027)
wvars <- c("swell_max_m", "wind_days", "rain_mm", "air_temp_hi", "marine_health")
ws    <- sort(unique(panel_f$fy))
X <- lapply(ws, function(w) {
  nd <- win %>% left_join(panel_f %>% filter(fy == w) %>% select(beach_nm, mon, all_of(wvars)), by = c("beach_nm", "mon"))
  model.matrix(delete.response(terms(glm_fit)), nd, xlev = glm_fit$xlevels)
})
off   <- log(win$visitors)
b_ok  <- !is.na(coef(glm_fit))
n_sim <- 5000
betas <- mvrnorm(n_sim, coef(glm_fit)[b_ok], vcov(glm_fit))
w_draw <- sample(seq_along(ws), n_sim, replace = TRUE)

sims <- t(sapply(seq_len(n_sim), function(s) {
  bb  <- betas[s, ]
  mu  <- as.numeric(exp(X[[w_draw[s]]][, b_ok, drop = FALSE] %*% bb + off))
  mun <- mu * exp(plan_delta(lg_add, dh_v, flag_v, camp_v, bb))
  c(base = sum(rnbinom(N, mu = mu, size = glm_fit$theta)),
    plan = sum(rnbinom(N, mu = mun, size = glm_fit$theta)),
    avoided = sum(mu) - sum(mun))
}))
q <- function(x) round(quantile(x, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)), 1)
rbind(no_extra_funding = q(sims[, "base"]), with_plan = q(sims[, "plan"]), expected_avoided = q(sims[, "avoided"]))
```

## 7. Alternatives, scored on the same model

-   **Spread evenly:** $25k per beach of casual lifeguard hours, the same every month.
-   **Summer-only patrols:** $2M of casual lifeguard hours in Nov to Feb, shared by visitors.
-   **Education only:** a campaign in every postcode where one can help (spend is below $2M).

```{r alternatives}
score <- function(lg_add, dr_add = 0, flag_b = rep(0, B), camp_p = rep(0, P)) {
  sum(win$mu0) - sum(win$mu0 * exp(plan_delta(lg_add, dr_add, flag_b, camp_p)))
}
even   <- rep(BUDGET / B / c_lg / 12, N)
summer <- ifelse(win$cal %in% SUMMER, win$visitors, 0); summer <- summer / sum(summer) * BUDGET / c_lg
edu_p  <- as.numeric(tapply(camp_gain, win$p, max) > 0)

alts <- tibble(
  option = c("Optimised plan", "Spread evenly", "Summer-only patrols", "Education only"),
  spend  = c(sum(cost), c_lg * sum(pmin(even, lg_room)), c_lg * sum(pmin(summer, lg_room)), c_camp * sum(edu_p)),
  avoided = c(avoided, score(even), score(summer), score(rep(0, N), 0, rep(0, B), edu_p))
) %>% mutate(cost_per_avoided = spend / avoided)
knitr::kable(alts, digits = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
```

## 8. Notes

-   First aid capacity and PA systems have coefficients at or above zero for severe incidents in the Part 1 model, so the optimiser does not buy them. Equipment rating has no price, so it is not a lever.
-   Effects are associations (Part 1 section 7). Lifeguards and drones were probably placed where risk is high, so if anything their effect is understated.
-   `log1p` hours give the first few hours at an unpatrolled beach-month a large effect. The minimum patrol block (`MIN_LG`) stops the solver from spreading patrols too thin to roster. Drones already fly small months in the data (5th percentile about 7 hours), so they get no block.
